title: Data Science Intern
job_description: Your role As a Data Sciene Intern your main responsibilities will involve: Lead discussion with the business stakeholders to better define the problem and identify and design the most suitable solution Lead the end-to-end implementation of data science initiatives to improve customer engagement, business processes and product enhancements through automation and actionable insights Analyze and review complex data from multiple internal and external sources to make informed, authoritative technical/professional recommendations to improve business performance in the medium and longer term. Engage with stakeholders to increase awareness and adoption of the solutions you build Your Skills And Experience As a Data Science Intern your skills and qualifications will ideally include: Bachelor’s degree in computer science, data science or other relevant subjects Able to lead and implement data science use cases to deliver measurable benefits Good knowledge of statistical and predictive modelling techniques such as machine learning, decision trees, probability networks, clustering, neural networks Experience in managing structured and unstructured data, including free text, images, web data and more Well versed in building on the cloud, best practices and languages such as Python Past data science project delivered is a plus Duration: 3 – 6 months
